caveats: No regional marine heatwave events were found in this region for 2004-06-01 to 2004-08-31: in every sea cell the summer-2004 SST stayed below the cell's smoothed 90th-percentile threshold except for 6 isolated cell-days (3 days) with exceedances of at most +0.14 K, so no run reached the 5-day minimum duration even before gap joining. Baseline pools additionally use days just outside the nominal baseline (1991-12-27 to 1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01 to 2003-01-05), as required by the method; they are reflected in baseline_analysed. Thresholds, climatology, smoothing and comparisons were computed in float64; SST was read as stored (kelvin, float32 source data cast to float64).
